answer: Because the forge audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and hence paying the inlet bond on all of them and exposing each to the opal slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 8 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Honest users pay that once, farms 23 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
